children: Apple (AAPL) fell 2.2% to $330.97, shedding about $107 billion in market value after its margin outlook. Nvidia overtook Apple, with a $5.01 trillion valuation versus Apple’s $4.83 trillion.
Apple Inc. (AAPL) said memory and storage constraints and rising costs are expected to intensify, and warned that price increases may not offset the impact and could reduce demand.
Apple’s €2,000-plus foldable iPhone faces supply shortages, with delivery estimates pushed to January. Dan Ives forecasts about 10 million sales over the next few quarters and keeps a $400 target.
Apple (AAPL) expects December-quarter revenue to grow 7%–10%, driven by demand for its new iPhones, especially the Duo, while memory costs and R&D spending weigh.
Mohan said Apple’s iPhone price hikes were milder than expected. He estimates owners could pay about $100 more over future upgrade cycles, supporting earnings if memory costs ease.
Apple launched the iPhone 18 Pro, Pro Max and foldable iPhone Duo near quarter-end. Most sales are expected in the holiday quarter, though the Duo’s contribution remains uncertain.
Apple returned $28 billion to shareholders last quarter as rising component prices, driven by data-center investment, increased costs.
Morningstar forecasts Apple’s iPhone revenue to grow at a high-single-digit rate in fiscal 2027, driven by higher prices and a $1,999 premium iPhone Duo, while unit sales remain flat.
Apple’s 1.5 billion iPhones and 2.5 billion iOS devices offer room to grow AI revenue. Dan Ives sees AI reaching 15%–20% of Services revenue in 18–24 months.
Apple Inc. (AAPL) CEO John Ternus is pursuing a product expansion that includes the company’s first foldable smartphone, the iPhone Duo, and its first touchscreen MacBooks.
